testcase.system-out: Scenario: Expand and collapse project settings with the keyboard ✔ Given the MCAD Software starts with `fixtures/cad/project-dialog-native/ActiveProject.opj` as its first project ✔ And the user opens the Projects dialog from the template chooser with `ActiveProject` active ✔ And `ActiveProject` displays collapsed Folder Options and Options groups ✔ When the user selects the collapsed Folder Options group ✔ And the user presses the Right Arrow key ✔ Then the group expands to show folder entries including Templates, Design Data and Presets ✔ When the user presses the Left Arrow key ✔ Then the Folder Options children are hidden ✔ When the user selects the collapsed Options group ✔ And the user presses the Right Arrow key ✔ Then the group expands to show project options including old versions to keep and unique file names ✔ And the active project remains marked in the project list
